scope: Read-only local inventory. No GPU, Slurm, SSH, remote mutation, training, model forward, or codec batch was run. Token lengths below use the pinned local tokenizer only.

current_cohort.selection_rule: The ordered 100-case source selection is two released-generation anchors plus the first-by-SHA256 entry from 98 distinct MP20 dataset space groups, with no replacement on failure. The interleaved adapter takes only selection cases [0:24]; first eight train and next sixteen are held out. The remaining 76 are outside this pilot by fixed-prefix scope, not per-case length, codec, or geometry filtering.

exclusion_reasons.evidence_limit: There are no individual rejection reasons: prepare.py slices all_ids[:24], the protocol says remaining IDs are not scanned, filtered, or replaced, and the separate 100-case relational run passed all 100 source-plan, geometry, canonical-text, and second-decode contracts.

verified_relational_cnl_v1_pool.source_encoding_reuse_for_additional_76: All 76 source CNL texts, source plans, and prepared facts already exist in the verified run100_001 cohort. A new adapter can reuse those pinned sources. It still needs to build and check two scaled edit targets per added case; these were not built for the remaining 76 in this audit.

mp20_basic.selection_coverage: 98 selected MP20 source rows are already represented in the frozen relational cohort; 27038 other unique train.csv material IDs remain in this local raw pool and have not been evaluated in the relational_cnl_v1 100-case cohort. They require fresh fact extraction, encoding, and geometry checks before use.

existing_corpus_512_inputs.use_boundary: These input CIFs are available source structures for fresh relational_cnl_v1 encoding. The legacy decoded and Wyckoff-decoded files are derived outputs and provide no relational_cnl_v1 generation evidence. The 423 IDs outside the frozen 100 have no relational_cnl_v1 validation in this audit.

enriched_train_view.interpretation: This is an enriched view with repeated material IDs, not 32289 distinct crystal structures; do not count its extra rows as additional training structures without investigating row-level provenance.

capacity_and_token_length.method: Pinned AutoTokenizer, add_special_tokens=false, plus one END token, counted from each existing run100_001 source text. No relational codec or model computation was invoked.
capacity_and_token_length.limit: For the remaining 76, source texts fit K. Their plus/minus edited-text lengths and full task pack lengths were not measured here; exact adapter preparation must confirm K and MAXLEN before training. The current 24-case trajectory result does not itself prove the larger adapter pack fits.

evidence.supports: 100-case selection rule, no-replacement rule, and dataset checksum
Fixed first-24 prefix and first-eight versus next-sixteen split
Existing prepared plan/facts/text/CIF inputs and the exact ID-prefix equality check
Remaining 76 out of pilot by scope; no filter/replacement; tokenizer capacity contract
Frozen IDs, K/MAXLEN, current 24-case lengths, split counts, and zero source/plus/minus reference failures
Separate offline relational_cnl_v1 run passed all 100 source-plan and geometry cases with zero API/LLM calls
Raw MP20 source records; CSV counts were read with Python csv so embedded multiline CIF fields are parsed as records
Existing validation and test CSV source inventories; record counts and checksums were computed locally
Three identical material-ID sets with 512 input CIFs each; ID-set counts and intersection with the relational selection were computed locally
